statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r has length 2, and r[0] equals the number of connected components of G, and r[1] equals the maximum size of a connected component of G, where G is the undirected graph on {0,...,len(words)-1} defined as follows: for each i, let S_i = { c in {0,...,25} | byte 97+c occurs in words[i] }; for i != j, i and j are adjacent in G iff (|S_i| = |S_j| and |S_i Delta S_j| <= 2) or (| |S_i| - |S_j| | = 1 and |S_i Delta S_j| = 1). A connected component is a maximal set of vertices connected by paths in G.
preconditions: words is a slice of vectors of bytes satisfying: 1 <= len(words) <= 20000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 26; each words[i] consists of distinct lowercase ASCII letters (bytes 97..122).
